label: CMP7345, locally patched (Is2 closed; body nets exposed in the reference)

added.text: * CMP7345, locally patched; not the upstream release.
* Changed (Apache-2.0 section 4(b)): four Xschem path comments are removed, and
* eleven cards expose the body nets sub! and nw: three .subckt pin lists, three
* x cards and five bulk terminals. See PROVENANCE.md beside this file.
